verdict.rationale: Snyk documents a secrets scanner (`snyk secrets test`) for hard-coded API keys and passwords, but nothing shows users can define custom detection rules for organization-specific token or secret formats. The documented custom-rule capabilities are for IaC (Rego SDK) and for DeepCode AI code queries. Those are adjacent features, not custom secret-detection rules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can define custom detection rules for my organization's internal token and secret formats
